Part B: Data Frames and Condition Statements

B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  section = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)




```

B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)

```

B3
```{r}


students[["average"]] <- round(mean((students[["final"]])) + mean((students[["midterm"]])),digits = 1)
students[["average"]]



```

B4
```{r}
students[["average"]] >= 70
students[["attendance"]] >= 75
```

B5
```{r}
students[["standing"]] <- ifelse(students[["average"]] >= 90, "Honors",
                         ifelse(students[["average"]] >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students[["standing"]]               

```


Part C

C1
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id = c(9, 10),
  name = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  gender = c("F", "M"),
  section = c("C", "A"),
  midterm = c(81, 70),
  final = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80)
)
new_students[["average"]] <- (new_students[["midterm"]] + new_students[["final"]]) / 2
new_students[["passed"]] <- new_students[["average"]] >= 60
new_students[["standing"]] <- ifelse(new_students[["passed"]], "Pass", "Fail")

missing_cols <- setdiff(names(students), names(new_students))
for (col in missing_cols) new_students[[col]] <- NA
new_students <- new_students[, names(students), drop = FALSE]

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)

```

C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 5, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)
class(students_all)
```


C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all[["midterm"]], final = students_all[["final"]])
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
```


C4
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all[["midterm"]], final = students_all[["final"]])
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))
```
